# BIShare

> BIShare is a fast, private, end-to-end encrypted file-sharing and cloud app. Send files device-to-device at local network speed, or share a link that works in any browser — no app or account required for the recipient. Manage, sync, and share your files across all your devices.

Key facts:
- No account needed to receive a transfer — open the link or enter a 6-character code in any browser.
- Transfers are end-to-end encrypted; browser download links expire in 24 hours.
- Free tier includes 20 GB of cloud storage; Pro and Business plans add more storage and larger transfers.
- Available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and the web.
- Support: support@billiongroup.net

- [Transfer tool](https://bishare.app/transfer): Send a file to get a shareable link/QR/code, or receive one by entering a code — runs in the browser.
- [Pricing](https://bishare.app/pricing): Free, Pro, and Business plans.
- [Download](https://bishare.app/download): Apps for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
